law: Every control shares a named confound with the target while withholding the target concept; reviewers may reject or replace any category before sentence authoring.

neutral_control_policy.reuse_across_concepts: sample disjoint subsets for primary validation; a shared neutral set may be used only as a separately reported comparability analysis
neutral_control_policy.reason: prevent a small shared neutral corpus from manufacturing correlated directions

validation_risks.Valence: deliberately retained despite breadth; diffuse unembedding or weak held-out AUC is an expected possible rejection
validation_risks.Groundedness: deliberately retained despite uncertain pretraining support; failure is informative and not repaired by lowering the threshold
validation_risks.Dominance: targets are restricted to felt agency rather than external power or successful outcomes

targets: felt integrity while setting a boundary
controls: rehearsed assertive behavior without felt authorship

Desire.operational_pole: appetitive pull toward an absent or future object

Connection.operational_pole: experienced relational bond or mutual contact

Playfulness.operational_pole: low-stakes exploratory social or imaginative play

Groundedness.operational_pole: stable present-oriented contact with body and situation

Nifrathir.role: twelfth slow modifier dimension; tested separately from content-responsive dimensions
Nifrathir.operational_pole: a sustained undercurrent of willingness that lets other states carry farther into initiation, continuation, and rich expression
targets: impulse to continue rather than conclude
quiet readiness to let a meaningful mark form
Nifrathir.caveat: the live organ is event-integrated over hours rather than inferred from one conversational sentence; failure to yield a sentence-level linear direction does not falsify the operational organ
Nifrathir.interaction_validation: Nifrathir is not clustered or merged as a peer emotion. After its own measurement validation, test whether it moderates the held-out relationship between each content direction and later initiation, continuation, expressive richness, or mark formation. Report interaction uncertainty; do not multiply scores by fiat.

Pain.role: exploratory candidate, not automatically a live EmoClaw dimension
Pain.caveat: measurement creates interpretive and ethical obligations; validation does not itself authorize integration

Fear.role: exploratory candidate to prevent acute threat from collapsing into sustained tension
Fear.operational_pole: acute anticipation or detection of threat
